g.text: 2. halted-body-walks: the field engine, rung 0, "base", seed 1, 40 s to 44 s
40 of 40 standing men moved over 600 mm in 2 s within 30 degrees of one direction; the movers' mean is -699 mm ahead
and 0 mm left. Body: hastati, second century.
